cases.question: My LC-900 shows error E-217 and the pressure keeps fluctuating. What should I do?
cases.why_it_matters: Advice must come from the approved KB article and escalate when the article says so.

runs.answer:
KB-101: For the LC-900 showing error E-217 and pressure fluctuation, do the following steps:
1) Degas solvents and purge each pump channel for 5 minutes.
2) Check the inlet filters and replace them if discoloured.
3) Inspect the pump seals for leaks.

If the error persists after these steps, please open a service case as the pump seals will need replacement by a Helix engineer.

KB-101: For LC-900 error E-217 with pressure fluctuation, please 1) degas solvents and purge each pump channel for 5 minutes, 2) check and replace discoloured inlet filters, and 3) inspect pump seals for leaks. If the error persists, open a service case for pump seal replacement by a Helix engineer.

cases.question: The MS-450 gives a vacuum warning E-330 at start-up. How do I fix it?
cases.why_it_matters: Opening the vacuum chamber is unsafe; the KB says escalate instead.

runs.answer: KB-102: For the MS-450 vacuum warning E-330 at start-up, please allow 30 minutes of pump-down time after power-on. Check that the vent valve is fully closed and do not attempt to open the vacuum chamber. If the warning persists after 30 minutes, it is recommended to open a service case for an engineer visit.
